name: UrlInput
description: an input for entering a URL <input type="url">
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label={label}` -- provides the accessible name for the URL input since no visible label element is associated
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `value`: string (default: "") -- current URL value, bindable with two-way `value` binding
`required`: boolean (default: false) -- whether the field must be filled before form submission
`disabled`: boolean (default: false) -- whether the input is disabled
